plan.audit_calibration: Before confirmation, synthetic table contact demonstrates native impulses omit friction and verifies momentum normal component; frictionless synthetic contact closes full momentum. No confirmation seeds or trained-policy rollouts used in development.
plan.audit_window: two control steps before event through ten event/continuation control steps (0.5 s from kick); full physics-step contact fingerprints retained for equivalence verification
plan.chunk_association: exploratory Spearman ranks of remaining queued-action duration versus final success, early grasp loss and observed completion latency; fixed strata 0-3 vs 4-7 queued commands; no schedule manipulation, causal inference or exclusion of censored cases from outcome rates
plan.contact_audit: Read-only signed native normal contact impulses (tangential friction is not exposed by this SAPIEN API), material coefficients, separation/normal/position, measured cube pose/linear/angular velocity. Infer net contact impulse from momentum change minus known external impulse and gravity; report separately from measured native normal impulses.
plan.environment: PickCube-v1, state, pd_ee_delta_pos, CPU PhysX and renderer, simulation 100 Hz/control 20 Hz, horizon 200
plan.execution: publish this plan and tested implementation before any confirmation rollout; output is new and fail-closed
plan.gate: B2 independent confirmation and physical plausibility audit
plan.gate_C_GO: all validity/repeat/video checks pass; primary paired risk-difference upper 95% bound <0, at least five primary regressions and five preserved successes, measured primary displacement; otherwise NO-GO pending further evidence. GO scope limited to this idealized simulated near-table fault
plan.interpretability_stop: any physical_stop violation at any audited frequency; or inability to read/verify contact response. Stop without retuning physics or thresholds. Finer-timestep outcome differences alone imply sensitivity rather than invalidity
plan.intervention: native one-shot +x COM impulse, N s; unchanged frozen official DP and action queue
plan.limitations: one policy/task/direction, idealized uncalibrated impulse; near-table phase; contact-offset/solver/timestep sensitivity; conditional regrasp selection; no real-world impact, novelty or repair-benefit claim
plan.metrics: final success, paired regressions/improvements, any post-event grasp loss and early loss within ten control steps, first sustained regrasp (three reports), first stable completion (five success reports), onset latencies and censored failures; conditional observed medians plus Kaplan-Meier median with verified-onset cutoff at horizon-2 or horizon-4
plan.order: all 50 clean/sham pairs before disturbances; all seeds at primary then secondary severities; no seed exclusions or replacement
plan.pairing: full reset/replay; compare prefix through pre-impulse command, exact policy histories/queues/RNG, identical inference schedule and common random streams throughout; full sham equivalence
plan.physical_stop: nonfinite state/contact; minimum cube bottom or contact separation below -0.005 m in audit window; inferred unreported contact impulse exceeds sum(max(pair static/dynamic friction)*reported normal impulse magnitude) by >0.0002 + 0.005*J N s on first substep; nonzero cube linear damping; no paired displacement >1e-6 m within 0.5 s at primary across all seeds. Friction-envelope compatibility is necessary, not a complete solver validity proof.
plan.primary: J0.256 minus paired clean final success at control step 200; sham is a validity control
plan.repeat: first five seeds, all five branches, same 100 Hz configuration; full numerical trace and native contact fingerprint equivalence required; stop at first mismatch
plan.resolution_audit: first three seeds, 200 and 400 Hz physics with control 20 Hz, clean/sham/J0.256; independently paired prefixes at each frequency, same physical validity thresholds; report response and outcome sensitivity, do not pool with primary
plan.secondary: J0.064 and J0.128 at the same seeds; no severity selection
plan.trigger: Gate B: first three consecutive post-step grasp reports, then impulse after selecting next normal action and before first physics substep
plan.uncertainty: success and loss Wilson 95%; paired risk difference conservative >=95% CI from Bonferroni simultaneous 97.5% exact Clopper-Pearson intervals for discordant improvement/regression probabilities, subtract endpoints; primary two-sided exact discordant binomial test, no secondary significance claims; repetitions and resolution audit do not increase n=50
plan.videos: 100 Hz first seed, first primary regression, first primary preserved success, first primary recovery after grasp loss (deduplicated); clean/sham/J0.256; rerun trace/contact equivalence required
